notes: Exploratory activity-only benchmark on the NOTSOFAR-1 repository's 10 s simulated CSS training sample. Three speaker slots exist in the tensor, but two speakers are active in this utterance. The official sample provides per-sample activity labels but no transcript, so WER/tcpWER and the challenge leaderboard metric cannot be computed. Two mono input derivations × three existing system modes. Local DER/JER scorer is not an official challenge scorer.
